manifest_server_entry.server: sanitized ConfigServer, snake_case keys — see sanitized_fields_blanked

notes: Baseline v2 export layout, pinning both manifest shapes at once. The wrapper fields (formatVersion/appConfigVersion/createdAt/sourceMachineName/servers, and per-entry folderName/javaPort/paperMCVersion/paperBuild/bundledPaperJar/pluginLinks) are plain Swift Codable with no CodingKeys override, so they serialize as literal camelCase on disk -- unlike the embedded `server` object, which inherits ConfigServer's own snake_case CodingKeys (AppConfig.swift:267-299). world/world_nether/world_the_end are bundled as live folders (source lines 192-204, via WorldSlotManager.worldFolderNames) even though ServerTransfer.excludedTopLevelDirs (lines 41-45) lists those exact three names -- confirmed by a whole-tree grep that the constant is declared once and referenced nowhere else, so it has zero effect on export; do not port it as exclusion policy. logs/cache/.git are simply never named in any copy list (jar, wholesale subs, libraries, live worlds, or the configFileExtensions-filtered configs/ pass), not filtered by the dead constant either. configFileExtensions (line 47-49) is exactly {properties, yml, yaml, json, txt, toml, conf}, case-insensitive on the extension; only top-level files (not subdirectories) in server_dir are scanned for configs/ (line 209-220).
